value.rationale: Connectedness of the ordinary-cell support controls a natural, previously unquantified singular phase: mutually independent rare Poisson counts decouple from the Gaussian row/column-constrained bulk, whereas the smallest disconnected case has locked Bessel counts. This is an explicit structural boundary in conditioned count models and entropic transport, not a textbook isolated arithmetic identity or arbitrary finite slice.
